notas: Valores de partida razonables, pendientes de afinar con fotos reales del rubro. wb_strength alto: en producto el color tiene que ser fiel al artículo real o generas devoluciones.

fondos.blanco-puro: Replace the background with a clean, pure white seamless studio backdrop, evenly lit with soft diffused light, with a subtle natural contact shadow directly beneath the product so it sits on the surface instead of floating. No gradients, no texture, no props.
fondos.gris-estudio: Replace the background with a smooth neutral light-grey seamless studio backdrop with a gentle vertical gradient, softly lit, with a natural soft shadow beneath the product.
fondos.podio-minimal: Replace the background with a minimal studio scene: a simple neutral podium or plinth in soft matte tones under clean diffused lighting, with a plain gradient wall behind and a soft realistic shadow under the product.
fondos.oscuro-premium: Replace the background with a deep dark seamless backdrop lit with a single soft directional key and a subtle rim light along the edge of the product, in the style of premium product photography. Keep the surface reflective enough to give a faint natural reflection beneath the product.

escenas.lanzamiento: Place the product in a premium launch scene with dramatic directional lighting, a clean minimal environment and generous empty space around it for a headline.
escenas.estilo-de-vida: Place the product in a tasteful lifestyle setting appropriate to its category, with the environment rendered softly out of focus so the product remains unmistakably the subject.

copy.tono: claro y concreto; beneficio primero, característica después; sin exageraciones vacías
